# Input for //bazel/helm:upstream_template_test_opts_selftest. Not a BUILD file:
# nothing loads it. Every call here passes the option the way the guard wants.

helm_template_test(
    name = "only_the_option",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
)

helm_template_test(
    name = "after_other_options",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = SHARED + [
        "--kube-version",
        "1.29.0",
        "--set",
        "edge.enabled=true",
        "--set",
        "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
    template_patterns = {
        "chart/templates/a.yaml": [
            "kind: Deployment",
        ],
    },
)
